title: QuarrionCraft SMP
description: A crossplay, and most version supported, vanilla server with little to no restriction.
body:
QuarrionCraft is a small vanilla+ semi-anarchy survival server built to keep Minecraft feeling like Minecraft, lightly salted without completely rewriting the base of the game. Can be played on most versions, even Bedrock!

Including Waystones; a better way to set homes without you unable to remove someone elses, if they set it in your base!

Also includes: Partial Keep Inventory, /tpa, Golden armor trims distract piglins, Fast leaf decay, Simple Voice Chat, and more!

PvP, raiding, and player freedom are part of the experience. You won't get punished for these!
